title: Power torsion of Hom from bounded finite-projective complexes
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and D(A) its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let r be in A and P be a cochain complex of A-modules with bounds a,b such that P^i is zero outside [a,b]; assume every P^i is finite and projective. Let M be any object of D(A), and suppose every element m of every H^i(M) is killed by some power of r. Then for every morphism alpha:Q(P) to M there is n>=0 such that r^n times alpha is zero. No boundedness or finiteness assumption is imposed on M, and no scheme or support comparison enters this lemma.

source.place: Tag 08EJ, affine paragraph (canonical text checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EJ)

proof.text: Induct on the length of a finite interval supporting P. The empty interval has P=0, so every morphism is zero. For a single finite projective term in degree t, projectivity identifies Hom_D(A)(P[-t],M) with Hom_A(P,H^t(M)). Take a finite generating set of P; for the image of each generator choose an annihilating exponent from the assumed elementwise torsion. The maximum exponent kills all images, and linearity kills the whole module map and therefore the derived morphism. The empty generating set needs exponent zero.

For a longer interval, use the stupid-truncation distinguished triangle P^b[-b] to P to sigma_le_(b-1)P. Restrict alpha to the first term and use the single-term case to kill it by r^a. The exact Hom sequence then lifts r^a alpha from the shorter truncation. Apply induction to that lift with exponent bprime. Composition is A-linear, hence r^bprime r^a alpha=0. Combine the powers with exponent a+bprime. This also works if an endpoint term is zero, and for r=0, a unit r, or the zero ring.

proof_origin.note: Stage-3 decomposition of the Stacks 08EJ affine proof; explicit model comparison and ring Hom induction are independent remaining tasks.

lean.statement:
theorem bounded_projective_hom_power_torsion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (r : A) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (P.X i))
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i))
    (hp : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i))
    (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hM : ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj M),
      ∃ n : ℕ, r ^ n • m = 0)
    (α : Q.obj P ⟶ M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, r ^ n • α = 0
